product_metadata.title: SUPERIOR Egyptian Cotton 3-Piece Towel Set, Basic Towels for Bathroom, Home Decor, Guest Bath, Shower, Apartment, Included 1 Face, 1 Hand, 1 Bath Towel, Washcloth, Quick Dry, Light Blue
features: OPULENT COMFORT: Egyptian Cotton terry loop is highly absorbent to get you dry quickly; single-ply for added comfort and durability; Set includes 1 bath towel, 1 hand towel, and 1 face towel/ washcloth

WHIMSICAL DESIGN: This elegant and classy set is available in any array of solid colors with a textured, rope border; update the look of your master or guest bath with these elegant towels; attached hanging loop allows you to easily hang your towel
GORGEOUS STYLE and APPEALING COLORS: Available in Burgundy, Black, Canary, Gold, Ivory, Light Blue, Mocha, Peach, Royal Purple, Sage, Sapphire, Silver, Toast, Taupe, White

EFFORTLESS CARE: Colorfast and machine washable; avoid using fabric softeners and dryer sheets, as those products may decrease absorbency; tumble dry low and remove them promptly from dryer; always follow care label instructions for best results

EXCELLENT GIFT: Our designs match a variety of styles and make great gifts; perfect for friends and familiy or any holiday; We're committed to make safe and sustainable products; OEKO-TEX certified to protect your skin and hair
description: Pamper yourself with our Egyptian Cotton Solid Bathroom Towel Set. Both exceptionally soft and highly absorbent, the Egyptian Cotton construction has a thick and luxurious feel to help get you dry quickly. For added comfort, each towel in this set features a medium towel weight that will keep you toasty warm as soon as you step out of the shower or bath. This towel set is available in various solid colors with a decorative rope-style trim to bring a clean and modern look to any master or guest bath.
